current.text: He projects as a possible bench microwave scorer, with an outside chance to start.
Minnesota's fifth starting spot is open. Ball, Edwards, McDaniels and Gobert are set. Jonathan Kuminga is expected to start but is not guaranteed the spot, and Josh Green might start.
Minnesota's bench is thin, has little scoring punch and has no ball handlers. That leaves room for a bench scorer.
Minnesota has a two-game week in the matchup starting March 15. That falls inside our fantasy playoffs.
Minnesota is expected to compete, with a prediction of 53 wins, so it should not rest players to tank.
